content:
anna-lee: quick sync — doing a tiny docs reorg for the SDK quickstarts, plus renaming sample-app to sample-kit to match new packaging. will open PR in ~30m.

jamal: thanks! any breaking link changes i should watch for in the console pages?

anna-lee: only internal paths. console redirects will be added, but i'll include a crosswalk table in the PR description so product pages can update after merge.

maria_g: fyi i saw a failing test in samples CI earlier, might be unrelated but tagging in case it blocks your build: https://ci.internal/redwood/samples/4821

anna-lee: @maria_g appreciate the heads up — i can rerun once PR is up. if it's flaky i can add a skip and follow up next sprint.

kevin: quick doc question: are we keeping the TypeScript quickstart in root + python in examples/ or switching both to examples/ for consistency?

anna-lee: leaning toward both in examples/ and a tiny top-level README that links to language-specific quickstarts. keeps repo tidy.

jamal: +1 for examples/ consolidation. also pinging @devex-bot for a link to the rollout checklist — want to make sure we run the doc link validator after deploy.

devex-bot: here is the checklist: https://internal.redwood.devex/checklists/doc-rollout — validator command: `./tools/link-checker --base-url https://docs.redwood.ai`

anna-lee: example changes i'll make in the PR:
- move ts-quickstart -> examples/ts-quickstart
- move py-quickstart -> examples/py-quickstart
- rename sample-app -> sample-kit and update package.json/name
- add redirect table and short migration guide in docs/quickstarts/migration.md

maria_g: can you include the small snippet needed for console redirects? i can review that part specifically.

anna-lee: yes, i'll add the Nginx redirect block and a note for Vercel config. snippet i'll include: ```
# nginx config
location /docs/quickstart/sample-app {
  return 301 $scheme://$host/docs/quickstarts/sample-kit$request_uri;
}
```

kevin: leaving a quick CR offer — can review the samples + README tomorrow morning.

jamal: i'll queue the doc link validator after merge. if anything breaks i can revert quickly.

anna-lee: plan for today: open PR (1955006792), attach CI rerun link, request reviews from @kevin and @maria_g, and land if green. blockers: waiting on samples CI flake to finish or a skip.

maria_g: noted, will monitor CI and do fast review once it's up.

devex-bot: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/921 — status: open — checks: running

anna-lee: thanks team :thumbsup:
